steps.label: 2456-own-copy2089239-concurrent-form-a-open
command: (() => {if(location.pathname!=='/item/all/detail.donga'||new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('itemId')!=='2089239'||document.querySelector('.modal.show'))throw Error('Own copy current detail required');const link=document.querySelector('a[data-modify-url]');if(!link?.dataset.modifyUrl.includes('itemId=2089239'))throw Error('Own observed modify link required');link.click();return {clickedHref:link.getAttribute('href')};})()

steps.label: 2460-own-copy2089239-concurrent-form-b-omr-controls
command: (() => {if(location.pathname!=='/item/all/modify.donga'||new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('itemId')!=='2089239'||document.getElementById('mfDifficulty').value!=='3')throw Error('Own untouched baseline B required');const root=document.querySelector('#omrSlot [data-omr-code]');return {url:location.href,editorUrl:document.querySelector('[data-editor-url]')?.dataset.editorUrl,code:root?.getAttribute('data-omr-code'),serialized:window.omrSerializers?.OBSACN?.serialize(root),controls:[...root.querySelectorAll('input,select,button')].map(e=>({tag:e.tagName,type:e.type,name:e.name,id:e.id,value:e.value,checked:e.checked,text:e.innerText,html:e.outerHTML.slice(0,550)}))};})()
